task.title: Keep it safe
task.shortdesc: Save a copy of your tree as a file, and keep it somewhere else too.

step.cmd: On the card for your tree, choose .
Choose how to save your tree.

choices.choice: saves the whole workspace in one file: the tree with its research notes, and the pictures and other attached files. Choose this one.

saves the family tree with its research notes, as a family tree file. It leaves out pictures and other attached files. Choose it only for a program that cannot read a GEDZIP file. If asks which version of GEDCOM to use, choose GEDCOM 7, unless the other program needs GEDCOM 5.5.1.

step.cmd: When Windows asks where to put the file, choose a folder you will remember.

result.p: You now have a copy. Make a new copy after you add a lot. Keep one on a USB stick or another drive too. A GEDZIP file is also the one to send to someone else who uses .
result.note: If you opened a file from another program, saves your changes to that file. To leave the original alone, make a copy first and open the copy. Keep the original safe too.
